body.name: One-step efficiency-gap estimator
body.construction:
Write \(\mu_R(x)=E_P[R_P(O)\mid X=x]\) and \(L_P(x)=(b^{\mathrm{cmp}})^{\prime}\Gamma_P(x)b^{\mathrm{cmp}}-b^{\star}(x)^{\prime}\Gamma_P(x)b^{\star}(x)\), so \(\Delta_{\mathrm{cmp}}(P)=E_P[L_P(X)]\). For any mean-zero observed score \(s\), define \(\dot p_{a,u,s}(x)=E_P[(\mathbf 1\{G=a,S=u\}-p_{a,u}(x))s(O)\mid X=x]\), \(\dot m_{a,u,v,s}(x)=E_P[\mathbf 1\{G=a,S=u\}\{\Delta Y_v-m_{a,u,v}(x)\}s(O)\mid X=x]/p_{a,u}(x)\), and \(\dot\pi_{g,1,s}=E_P[(\mathbf 1\{G=g,S=1\}-\pi_{g,1})s(O)]\). For \(k=(g,t)\), \(\dot q_{k,c,s}=\sum_{v=g}^t(\dot m_{g,1,v,s}-\dot m_{g,0,v,s}-\dot m_{c,1,v,s}+\dot m_{c,0,v,s})\), and, writing \(
u_k=E_P[p_{g,1}(X)q_{k,c_0(k)}(X)]\), \(\dot	heta_{k,s}=\{E_P[(p_{g,1}q_{k,c_0(k)}-
u_k)s]+E_P[\dot p_{g,1,s}q_{k,c_0(k)}+p_{g,1}\dot q_{k,c_0(k),s}]\}/\pi_{g,1}-
u_k\dot\pi_{g,1,s}/\pi_{g,1}^2\). Put \(e_{a,u,k}=\sum_{v=g}^t(\Delta Y_v-m_{a,u,v})\), \(\dot e_{a,u,k,s}=-\sum_{v=g}^t\dot m_{a,u,v,s}\), \(w_{a,u}=p_{g,1}/p_{a,u}\), and \(\dot w_{a,u,s}=(\dot p_{g,1,s}p_{a,u}-p_{g,1}\dot p_{a,u,s})/p_{a,u}^2\). If \(F_{k,c}\) denotes the bracketed numerator in Definition \(ef{def:pairwise-score}\), then \[\dot F_{k,c,s}=\mathbf 1_{g,1}(\dot q_{k,c,s}+\dot e_{g,1,k,s})-\mathbf 1_{g,0}(\dot w_{g,0,s}e_{g,0,k}+w_{g,0}\dot e_{g,0,k,s})-\mathbf 1_{c,1}(\dot w_{c,1,s}e_{c,1,k}+w_{c,1}\dot e_{c,1,k,s})+\mathbf 1_{c,0}(\dot w_{c,0,s}e_{c,0,k}+w_{c,0}\dot e_{c,0,k,s}),\qquad \dot R_{k,c,s}=\dot F_{k,c,s}/\pi_{g,1}-R_{k,c}\dot\pi_{g,1,s}/\pi_{g,1}.\] Set \(\dot h_{k,s}=(\dot p_{g,1,s}q_{k,c_0(k)}+p_{g,1}\dot q_{k,c_0(k),s})/\pi_{g,1}-p_{g,1}q_{k,c_0(k)}\dot\pi_{g,1,s}/\pi_{g,1}^2-\dot	heta_{k,s}\), \(\dot\mu_{R,s}=E_P[(R_P-\mu_R)s\mid X]+E_P[\dot R_s\mid X]\), and \[\dot\Gamma_s=E_P[\{(R_P-\mu_R)(R_P-\mu_R)^{\prime}-\Gamma_P\}s\mid X]+E_P[(\dot R_s-\dot\mu_{R,s})(R_P-\mu_R)^{\prime}+(R_P-\mu_R)(\dot R_s-\dot\mu_{R,s})^{\prime}\mid X].\] Then \[\dot\Omega_s=E_P[\{\Gamma_P(X)+Ah(X)h(X)^{\prime}A^{\prime}-\Omega_P\}s]+E_P[\dot\Gamma_s(X)+A\{\dot h_s(X)h(X)^{\prime}+h(X)\dot h_s(X)^{\prime}\}A^{\prime}].\] For the applicable comparator KKT matrix \(K_P\) and fixed right-hand side \(y\), use \[D K_P^{\dagger}[E]=-K_P^{\dagger}EK_P^{\dagger}+K_P^{\dagger}K_P^{\dagger\prime}E^{\prime}(I-K_PK_P^{\dagger})+(I-K_P^{\dagger}K_P)E^{\prime}K_P^{\dagger\prime}K_P^{\dagger}\] with \(E\) the block insertion of \(\dot\Omega_s\); \(\dot b^{\mathrm{cmp}}_s\) is the loading block of \(D K_P^{\dagger}[E]y\), block by block for OVS. Local constant KKT rank makes this derivative valid. The exact pathwise derivative, with the pointwise optimizer term removed by its envelope equation and the comparator term retained, is \[D\Delta_{\mathrm{cmp},P}[s]=E_P[\{L_P(X)-\Delta_{\mathrm{cmp}}(P)\}s]+E_P[\operatorname{tr}\{(b^{\mathrm{cmp}}b^{\mathrm{cmp}\prime}-b^{\star}(X)b^{\star}(X)^{\prime})\dot\Gamma_s(X)\}]+2E_P[\{\Gamma_P(X)b^{\mathrm{cmp}}\}^{\prime}\dot b^{\mathrm{cmp}}_s].\] Start with the bounded dictionary \(v_{J_n}\). On each training complement, estimate \(Z=N^{\prime}R\), \(H\), and \(E[Z\{v_j-Ev_j\}\mid X]\); form \(\widehat t_j^{-\ell}=v_j-\mathbb E_{-\ell}v_j-\widehat a_j^{-\ell}(X)^{\prime}\widehat Z\), where \(\widehat a_j^{-\ell}=\{\widehat H^{-\ell}\}^{\dagger}\widehat E_{-\ell}[\widehat Z\{v_j-\mathbb E_{-\ell}v_j\}\mid X]\), and center it on the training fold. Replace \(p,m,q,\pi,	heta,R,h,\Gamma,\Omega,b^{\star},b^{\mathrm{cmp}}\) in every displayed directional formula by their training-fold estimates and replace conditional expectations by the same finite-support or series regressions used for \(\widehat\Gamma^{-\ell}\). Evaluation at \(s=\widehat t_j^{-\ell}\) gives \(\widehat g^{-\ell}_{\Delta,J_n}\), while \(\widehat G^{-\ell}_{J_n}=\mathbb E_{-\ell}[\widehat t^{-\ell}_{J_n}\widehat t^{-\ell\prime}_{J_n}]\) and \(\widehat\zeta^{-\ell}_{\Delta,J_n}(O)=\widehat t^{-\ell}_{J_n}(O)^{\prime}\{\widehat G^{-\ell}_{J_n}\}^{\dagger}\widehat g^{-\ell}_{\Delta,J_n}\). The training plug-in is \[\widetilde\Delta^{-\ell}_{\mathrm{cmp}}=\mathbb E_{-\ell}[(\widehat b^{-\ell,\mathrm{cmp}})^{\prime}\widehat\Gamma^{-\ell}(X)\widehat b^{-\ell,\mathrm{cmp}}-\widehat b^{-\ell}(X)^{\prime}\widehat\Gamma^{-\ell}(X)\widehat b^{-\ell}(X)].\] Aggregate \(\widetilde\Delta^{-\ell}_{\mathrm{cmp}}+|I_\ell|^{-1}\sum_{i\in I_\ell}\widehat\zeta^{-\ell}_{\Delta,J_n}(O_i)\) with weights \(|I_\ell|/n\), and compute \(\widehat V_{\Delta,\mathrm{cmp}}\) and \(T_{\Delta,\mathrm{cmp}}\) as declared.
